name: ak-shopping-markets
description: Myanmar retail, wholesale, inventory and shopping center management app

scripts.copy-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['app.html','spark-pos-store.js','ak-health-monitor.js','firebase-config.js','ak-logo.svg','manifest.webmanifest','sw.js','download.html','USER-GUIDE-MY.md','USER-GUIDE-EN.md','BUSINESS-GUIDE-MY.md','BUSINESS-GUIDE-EN.md','PRINTER-SETUP-MY.md']){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('www',f==='app.html'?'index.html':f));else if(f==='app.html')throw new Error('Missing app.html');}fs.copyFileSync('app.html',path.join('www','app.html'));" && node scripts/copy-zxing.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
